messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU queue length > 95th percentile for 6m on cluster-prod-gpu. Autoscale attempted 3x and hit max_scale_limit. ticket=INC-3045
sam.sre: grabbing this. saw the surge alert, checking autoscaler logs now.
maria.runtime: I'm seeing lots of MIG allocation failures in the scheduler logs: `allocation failed: insufficient capacity for MIG profile 1g.20g` — looks like fragmentation + wrong MIG sizing for recent model config.
theo.ml: we rolled model v2.3 to prod 09:40 UTC which increased per-request memory by ~18%. could be correlated.
sam.sre: queue length: 18k pending. currently 99% GPU util on nodes; scheduler reports 1.2k pods pending due to alloc failures.
priya.cs: FYI a few enterprise customers reported elevated latency and 429s. CS is triaging and sending status updates.
pagerduty-bot: incident created INC-3045. Pager duty oncall: @sam.sre. Severity: P1.
ira.oncall: I'm coming in as secondary oncall, taking followups if you need to handoff.
sam.sre: quick check: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts but cloud quota prevented new instances (account quota error). also we hit an autoscale safety cap (budget cap) configured in 2.1.0. see logs:
```
Autoscaler: scale_up_attempts=3
CloudAPI: AllocateInstances -> 403 QuotaExceeded: "GPU quota exceeded for project"
Autoscaler: reached user-configured max_nodes=120
Scheduler: allocation_errors: [MIGMismatch,Fragmentation]
```
maria.runtime: MIGMismatch is key — nodes have a mix of MIG profiles (1g.10g, 1g.20g) after last rolling upgrade. Binpacking wants uniform slices; fragmentation left small unusable fragments.
sam.sre: can we short-circuit by forcing Pods to accept smaller MIG profile? Any model compatibility reqs from ML side?
theo.ml: v2.3 needs >= 12GB GPU per worker. We have pods requesting 16GB MIG slices. We can temporarily launch a v2.3-light variant that uses 8GB if runtime team approves minor precision loss.
ira.oncall: immediate mitigation options:
- 1) emergency increase quota with cloud & bump budget cap (slow, needs approval)
- 2) evict low-priority batch jobs to free MIGs (fast)
- 3) roll back to v2.2 model (fast if infra supports quick rollback)
- 4) manual node spin-up with specific MIG profile (requires cloud team)
sam.sre: evicting batch jobs now. tagging low-priority pods with `evict=now`.
deploy-bot: batch-queue/worker-*-000 evicted by sam.sre at 09:58 UTC.
priya.cs: telling customers we have active mitigations; will send ETA 30m.
maria.runtime: also starting a targeted repack attempt to consolidate MIG allocations on a subset of nodes (will cause short-term churn). running: `./repack --target-pool=pool-gpu-repack --drain=true`.
```
Repack: migrating 24 pods, estimated 90s per node
Scheduler: attempting binpack consolidation
```
sam.sre: note: repack sometimes triggers transient 500s for in-flight requests — add to customer message.
theo.ml: I'm validating v2.3-light config; can build model variant in 10m and push as canary.
ira.oncall: I'm going to raise slack thread to eng-runtime and cloud-ops for quota acceleration. @maria.runtime @sam.sre please post relevant logs.
maria.runtime: adding logs: `sched.log` snippets:
```
[09:52:12] allocation_error: "MIGFragmented: node-34 has available GPU memory 14G but available MIG profiles 0x1, cannot satisfy 16G requirement"
[09:53:00] binpack: free_slices=58 total_mig_slots=192 fragmented_slots=73
```
sam.sre: manual mitigation sequence so far:
- evicted 120 batch pods (freed ~6 MIG slices)
- started repack on pool-gpu-repack (inflight)
- kicked off v2.3-light build (theo)
- alerted cloud for quota bump
priya.cs: posted to affected customers: "We have active mitigation; some requests may be delayed but we’ve started evictions and repacking. ETA 30–45m."
deploy-bot: rollbacks available: service/model-runtime can rollback to v2.2 with `kubectl set image deployment/model-runtime model=image:2.2`.
sam.sre: decision: if repack + evictions don't drop queue below 5k in 20m, we will rollback to v2.2 and force canary for v2.3-light.
ira.oncall: handoff in 25m — @ira.oncall will take lead after that. Sam, stay on standby for rollback approval.
sam.sre: ACK. I'll keep monitoring.
maria.runtime: repack progress: 40% complete, freed 9 MIG slices so far, scheduler pending reduced to 840 pods.
theo.ml: v2.3-light canary image built and pushed to registry; readiness probe green on canary lane.
sam.sre: queue now 6.2k pending, CPU on control-plane spiking slightly but GPU util down to 94%.
priya.cs: updated customers with new ETA 20m.
ira.oncall: 20m check — if queue < 4k we'll avoid rollback. keep repack + canary routing.
maria.runtime: repack complete. freed 18 MIG slices total. scheduler pending now 2.1k -> 420.
sam.sre: nice. autoscaler attempting new nodes now; cloud quota response changed to 200 OK after manual quota bump by cloud-ops.
cloud-ops (via msg): increased GPU quota for project by 30 units at 10:24 UTC.
sam.sre: autoscaler spun up 12 new nodes with uniform MIG profile 1g.10g which match smaller-slice pods. scale completed.
theo.ml: canary routing for v2.3-light shows error rate slightly higher but latency back to acceptable 95th. moving 30% traffic to canary.
priya.cs: customers reporting latency normalized, some saw transient errors during repack but overall recovering.
sam.sre: putting incident into monitoring state. queue back to 120 pending, GPU util 68%.
ira.oncall: taking lead now for postmortem. Sam, handoff complete. Thanks for triage.
sam.sre: handing off — leaving notes in INC-3045.
priya.cs: will send final customer update in 15m.
pagerduty-bot: incident status -> monitoring. responders: sam.sre -> ira.oncall -> maria.runtime -> theo.ml.
maria.runtime: quick root cause hypothesis: v2.3 increased per-worker GPU memory request coincided with a heterogenous MIG profile mix after a prior node upgrade. Autoscaler hit configured max and cloud quota, causing inability to provision uniform MIG nodes, leaving fragmented small slices that couldn't satisfy larger pod requests — resulted in long queue and customer impact.
ira.oncall: post-incident action items (high priority):
- break fix: add emergency fallback to route traffic to lower-memory variant automatically when pending queue > threshold (owner: eng-ml)
- infra: add autoscaler quota alarms and automatic escalation to cloud-ops (owner: eng-infra)
- runtime: enforce MIG profile homogenization during node rolling upgrades or provide scheduler hints to prefer coalescing (owner: eng-runtime)
- runbook: update GPU-stranding runbook with explicit eviction and repack steps and communication templates (owner: eng-sre)
- product: add model rollout gating checks for per-request GPU memory delta > 10% (owner: product)
sam.sre: adding all to INC-3045 and assigning. tagging follow-up meeting tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
priya.cs: will coordinate customer postmortem notes and timing.
theo.ml: will prepare v2.3-light perf doc and tradeoffs for PM review.
sam.sre: closing thread for live incident; will reopen if metrics re-escalate. :white_check_mark:
